title: Pebble delta disappears on refresh
symptom: Using the 'Pebble Trend Clay Version', if 'display delta' is enabled under Pebble Integration in xDrip, the delta initially appears on the watchface but disappears whenever the watchface refreshes (e.g., once a minute has passed or time changes). Saving settings in the Pebble app temporarily brings it back until the next refresh.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. The watchface creator mentions there are issues on the xDrip side where messages to the Pebble are built, but no specific cause is confirmed.
fix: No resolution is provided in the thread. The issue was closed without a fix; the reporter switched to another watchface.
evidence_quote: I do know there are some issues on the xDrip side where the messages to the pebble are built, so I need to get that sorted.
